## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Dry-run output prints original and distilled token estimates per transcript...

The system SHALL ensure that dry-run output prints original and distilled token estimates per transcript and the reduction is at least 90 percent on the golden fixtures.

#### Scenario: Dry-run output prints original and distilled token estimates per transcript...

WHEN `add-transcript-distillation-and-evidence-cache` is implemented
THEN Dry-run output prints original and distilled token estimates per transcript and the reduction is at least 90 percent on the golden fixtures.

### Requirement: Distilled output for a fixture containing a fake API key contains no...

The system SHALL ensure that distilled output for a fixture containing a fake API key contains no substring of that key (redaction test).

#### Scenario: Distilled output for a fixture containing a fake API key contains no...

WHEN `add-transcript-distillation-and-evidence-cache` is implemented
THEN Distilled output for a fixture containing a fake API key contains no substring of that key (redaction test).

### Requirement: Running twice over the same transcripts with an unchanged surface hash makes...

The system SHALL ensure that running twice over the same transcripts with an unchanged surface hash makes zero model calls on the second run; changing one skill description invalidates only the cached entries whose analysis referenced it.

#### Scenario: Running twice over the same transcripts with an unchanged surface hash makes...

WHEN `add-transcript-distillation-and-evidence-cache` is implemented
THEN Running twice over the same transcripts with an unchanged surface hash makes zero model calls on the second run; changing one skill description invalidates only the cached entries whose analysis referenced it.
